annotations.title: Pick black or white text for a background

description: Use when the user asks what text color (black or white) to put on a given background, button or brand color so it is readable. Returns the better of black or white with both contrast ratios, the WCAG grade and a softer near-black option. Example: {"background": "#ff5a1f"}.

background.description: The surface color the text sits on.
